_about: Pose words for the trainer front animation, side by side (2026-11-22). Key = animated class (a/0/5/8) whose intro script is used; list item j = what pose j+1 shows (pose 0 = the battle sprite itself). Written from Origin's real cells, about the BODY, not the leader's props, so the person keeps their own things. Used in the text: '... in a new pose: the trainer {words}'.
